y-m-81-06.title: Ukuba incopho enye isebenza, ingaba lonke ipatheni liyasebenza?
y-m-81-06.goal: Fumana iindibaniselwano ezininzi apho ii-engile kwincopho enye zidibana zibe yi-360°, uze ugweba ukuba le meko ayonelanga ukuzalisa iplani yonke.
y-m-81-06.material: Xa wenza ipatheni, udibanisa iithayile zepholigoni eqhelekileyo ngaphandle kwezikhewu okanye ukugqitha. Ii-engile zeethayile ezidibana kwincopho enye kufuneka zidibane zibe yi-360°. Ubungakanani be-engile enye ye-n-gon eqhelekileyo imiselwe yi-n (unxantathu oqhelekileyo 60°, ikwere eqhelekileyo 90°, ihegzagoni eqhelekileyo 120°). Kulo msebenzi sijonga kuphela imeko apho amapholigoni amathathu aqhelekileyo adibana kwincopho enye, yaye inani lamacala linani lemvelo ukusuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-50.
y-m-81-06.prereq.1: Ubungakanani be-engile engaphakathi yepholigoni eqhelekileyo (ijiyometri yesikolo samabanga aphakathi), ukusombulula amaqhezu neemlinganiselo
y-m-81-06.prereq.2: Ingqiqo yamapholigoni aqhelekileyo ajikelezayo ichaphazelo (ii-engile ezidibana zibe jikelo olupheleleyo)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.prompt: Qikelela kuqala. Ngaphandle kwamahegzagoni amathathu aqhelekileyo (6,6,6), zeziphi ezinye iindibaniselwano zamapholigoni amathathu aqhelekileyo kwincopho enye apho ii-engile zidibana zibe yi-360°? (I-n-gon inamacala angu-n, yaye n ingama-50 ubuninzi.)
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ukuba kukho unxantathu oqhelekileyo o-1 (60°), cinga ukuba isixa sii-engile zamapholigoni amanye amabini kufuneka sibe yintoni.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sebenzisa indlela efanayo xa kukho ikwere eqhelekileyo e-1 (90°), uze ufumane iindibaniselwano ezimbalwa.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.a: Amapholigoni aqhelekileyo angengonxantathu, ikwere nehegzagoni aqhelekileyo (njengeoktagoni eqhelekileyo) anee-engile nawo. Kuthekani ukuba uvavanya enye okanye ezimbini kuzo?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.b: Hlola nokuba zikho iindibaniselwano ezingenaxantathu oqhelekileyo. Kuthekani ngezixa ezibandakanya ipentagoni eqhelekileyo okanye ioktagoni eqhelekileyo?
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.c: Ushiye ivulekile ukuba amapholigoni angengonxantathu, ikwere nehegzagoni aqhelekileyo anokusetyenziswa. Unokuvavanya ngokuthe ngqo ukuhlola inani.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.r.d: Kunzima ukufumana isizathu sokuba kukho enye kuphela ngakumbi. Bala ngokuthe ngqo ukuba zingaphi iindibaniselwano onokuzenza ngamapholigoni angengonxantathu, ikwere nehegzagoni aqhelekileyo.
y-m-81-06.s.s1.explain: Ukuba uzifuna wena kwinyathelo elilandelayo, uya kufumana ukuba zikho iindibaniselwano ezili-10 ngokupheleleyo, kubandakanya (6,6,6).
y-m-81-06.s.s2.prompt: Fumana ufake iindibaniselwano ezi-4 ezahlukeneyo apho i-a-gon eqhelekileyo, i-b-gon eqhelekileyo ne-c-gon eqhelekileyo zidibana kwincopho enye yaye ii-engile zidibana zibe yi-360° kanye. (3 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ 50, zonke ziyinani lemvelo. Bala indibaniselwano enocwangciso olwahlukileyo njengefanayo.)
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.0: Yenza itafile yobungakanani be-engile enye ye-n-gon eqhelekileyo uze ubhale ezimbalwa uqala ku-3.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.hint.1: Khetha elona a lincinci, ufumane ukuba isixa sii-engile ezimbini ezisalayo kufuneka sibe yintoni, uze utshintshe b.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Amanani amacala ngamanani emvelo ukusuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-50.
y-m-81-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Amanani amacala kufuneka abe ngamanani emvelo ukusuka kwi-3 ukuya kwi-50.

y-m-81-06.s.s2.ok.c3: Ii-engile ezintathu zidibana zibe yi-360° kanye.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.prompt: Jonga (5,5,10) phakathi kwezindibaniselwano ofumeneyo. Kwincopho enye, iipentagoni ezimbini eziqhelekileyo kunye nedekagoni e-1 eqhelekileyo zinokuzalisa i-360°. Ngoko ingaba le ndibaniselwano yodwa inokwenza ipatheni ezalisa iplani yonke ngaphandle kwezikhewu?
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.0: Zoba iincopho zemizobo ekufuphi ecaleni kwecala elinye ledekagoni eqhelekileyo uze uhlole ukuba indibaniselwano efanayo iyaqhubeka.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.hint.1: Xa iipentagoni ezimbini eziqhelekileyo zidibana ecaleni, hlola ukuba incopho ekufuphi nayo inika indibaniselwano efanayo.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.a: Ukuhambelana kwindawo enye akwanelanga ukwazi. Kufuneka uhlole ngokwahlukileyo ukuba iincopho ezikufuphi nazo ziyahambelana.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.a: Wahlule ukuhambelana kwindawo enye kukuhambelana kuyo yonke indawo. Uhlele oko kuyimeko efunekayo nokuyimeko eyanelisayo.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.b: Kuphela (4,6,12), indibaniselwano esebenzisa zonke iintlobo ezintathu, inokuzalisa iplani yonke ngaphandle kwezikhewu.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.b: (6,6,6) kunye (4,8,8) nazo zineepatheni ezizalisa iplani yonke. Inani leentlobo asingumgangatho.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.c: Ii-engile kwincopho enye zidibana ngokufanelekileyo, ngoko ukuqhubeka ngendlela efanayo kuya kuhlala kuzalisa iplani yonke.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.c: Ii-engile kwichaphazelo elinye ukudibana ngokufanelekileyo yimeko efunekayo. Ukuba iincopho ezikufuphi nazo zisebenza nge-indibaniselwano efanayo kuyimeko eyahlukileyo.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.o.d: Inani leendibaniselwano ezisebenza kwincopho enye lihlala lilingana nenani leepatheni ezizalisa iplani.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.r.d: Umbuzo kukuba yonke indibaniselwano izalisa iplani yonke na. Akukho sizathu sokuba inani leendibaniselwano nenani leepatheni zilingane.
y-m-81-06.s.s3.explain: Ii-engile kwincopho enye ukudibana zibe yi-360° yimeko efunekayo, hayi eyanelisayo. Ngokwaziwayo, kwezi-10 ezingentla, (3,12,12), (4,6,12), (4,8,8), kunye (6,6,6) kuphela ezizalisa iplani yonke ngohlobo olunye lolungiselelo lwencopho, yaye (5,5,10) ayinakuzalisa iplani yonke kuba ukuqhubeka kwiincopho ezikufuphi kukhokelela ekuphikisaneni.
